ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Commanding good and forbidding evil? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Commanding good and forbidding evil.
   B. Use Commanding good and forbidding evil to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Commanding good and forbidding evil with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Commanding good and forbidding evil has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara.
   C. Say Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue.
   B. Say Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in revealed scriptures? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in revealed scriptures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Belief in revealed scriptures to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Belief in revealed scriptures has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in revealed scriptures.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Ulul-Azm Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulul-Azm Prophets.
   B. Use Ulul-Azm Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Ulul-Azm Prophets has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Ulul-Azm Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

7. Which response best shows understanding of Modes of preservation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj and Umrah? (1 mark)

   C. Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj and Umrah.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Selected verses? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected verses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ulum al- Hadith has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah? (1 mark)

12. Which response best shows understanding of Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions .
   B. Use Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Modes of preservation of the Qur’an and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Selected verses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Ulum al- Hadith and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
